svg.text: 5 non-negotiable rules for AI in design

g.text: No PHI or patient data enters any AI tool.
AI Output Is Always a Draft
Everything requires human review by someone
accountable for the result. No exceptions.
Deliverables note where AI assisted, so review
Sanctioned tools + lightweight process for new ones.
AI fluency is a team competency. Structured learning,
shared prompts, regular retros on what worked.
